# Auger

Auger is aimed at long-form writing, stripping visual noise from the interface in favour of typography, generous line spacing and font smoothing. Its sidebar is styled to stay unobtrusive, and both light and dark modes are supported. It also carries styling of its own for the Kanban and Style Settings plugins.

![Auger screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davidgolding/obsidian-auger/HEAD/img/hero.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Auger"
    author: "David Golding"
    repo:   "davidgolding/obsidian-auger"
    slug:   "auger"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/auger"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/davidgolding/obsidian-auger"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davidgolding/obsidian-auger/HEAD/img/hero.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Prioritize long-form writing with a minimalist, readable interface that removes visual noise. Use pristine typography, generous line spacing, and font smoothing for comfortable reading. Enjoy a sleek, unobtrusive sidebar, light/dark modes, and custom styling for Kanban and Style Settings."
}
```
